_comment: Post-Deploy Smoke Suite configuration. Edit this file to control which functions are verified after a QA deploy.

_notes.crawlMenus: Set to true to automatically crawl all top-level menus and detect dead links / error dialogs before running functions.
_notes.stopOnFailure: Set to true to abort the entire suite on first failure. Default false = run all and report at the end.
_notes.sequence: List function NAMEs in the order they should be verified. Each NAME must match a recorded function in tests/e2e/functions/TC-<NAME>.spec.ts. Add more names here to include additional flows -- no code change required.
